scope: Explanation archive and preview implementation; no national success-rate or causal-effect estimate

observation.result: Read the 94-page report and all canonical records; reconcile every case, program, event and source ID to Excel; byte-match PDF, JSON and XLSX to the supplied Drive files.

depth.result: Distinguish vehicle and technology continuity, service continuity, program termination, funding and measured outcomes. Preserve causal uncertainty; do not infer current operation from absent end notices.

breadth.result: Retain all 111 cases and unsuccessful, suspended, changed and unknown observations; search related Drive reports; do not import ungrounded claims from older summaries.

structure.result: Stable IDs and aliases connect histories, policies and sources. Time grouping follows original year/fiscal-year labels, and sort bounds are never displayed as event dates.

refutation.result: Test missing dates, merged source observations, unconfirmed continuity, different services in the same city, funding attribution, monetary bases and source references.

decision.decision: Review the preview and approve the publication scope before any production change
decision.criteria: Correct counts and histories; readable PC/mobile views; source gaps visible; existing site untouched

execution.result: Preview, scoped source, checks and link audit prepared. A clean isolated final browser pass and approval of public downloads remain before release.

learning.result: Append new source-backed events without deleting prior history; refresh the ledger and independent count controls; regenerate and rerun relevant checks for each release.
